name: io.github.s402-protocol/s402-mcp
description: MCP server that lets AI agents pay for APIs using the s402 protocol on Sui. Handles HTTP 402 negotiation automatically — discover price, sign transaction, pay, get data.

tools.name: s402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL with automatic s402/x402 payment handling. If the server returns 402, signs a Sui transaction and retries with payment.

tools.name: s402_check_price
tools.description: Check what a URL costs without paying. Returns price, accepted schemes, and whether you can afford it.

tools.name: s402_balance
tools.description: Check your Sui wallet balance and session spending.
